spec.description: Upgrade backlog, pending reboots, and unattended-upgrades runs.

spec.title: Hosts reporting
spec.description: Hosts with a sample in the last hour.

Latest sample per host in the last hour, whatever the dashboard range.
- `Uptime` is in days.

spec.expr: max by (host) (label_replace(time() - node_boot_time_seconds * on (instance) group_left (nodename) topk by (instance) (1, node_uname_info), "host", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)")) / 86400 and on (host) max by (host) (last_over_time(apt_upgrades_pending{host=~"$host"}[1h]))

max by (host, distro) (label_join(label_replace(node_os_info * on (instance) group_left (nodename) topk by (instance) (1, node_uname_info), "host", "$1", "nodename", "(.*)"), "distro", " ", "name", "version_id")) and on (host) max by (host) (last_over_time(apt_upgrades_pending{host=~"$host"}[1h]))

spec.title: Security upgrades pending
spec.description: A host that stays above zero across a night means unattended-upgrades did not run.

spec.title: Errors
spec.description: Journal lines from `unattended-upgrade` matching `error`, `fail`, `traceback` or `exception`, newest first.

spec.title: Held packages
spec.description:
Packages a dpkg hold pins to their installed version, latest sample per host in the last hour.
- `Version` is the candidate the hold keeps out.

spec.title: Security packages
spec.description: Packages the next `unattended-upgrades` run will install, latest sample per host in the last hour.

spec.title: Security upgrades
spec.description: What the nightly `unattended-upgrades` run will install.
Counts `unattended-upgrades` runs that had packages to install, by whether the install step succeeded.

spec.expr: sum(count_over_time({syslog_id="unattended-upgrade", hostname=~"$host"} |= `Installing the upgrades failed!` [$__interval])) or vector(0)

spec.title: Packages by run
spec.description:
Packages each `unattended-upgrades` run selected, newest 1000 rows.
- A run whose install step failed still lists its packages.

spec.expr: {syslog_id="unattended-upgrade", hostname=~"$host"} |= `Packages that will be upgraded:` | pattern `Packages that will be upgraded: <packages>` | keep hostname, packages

spec.title: Upgrades pending
spec.description: Packages with a newer candidate. Phased rollouts held back for a machine are excluded.

spec.title: Upgrades held
spec.description: Packages with a newer candidate that a dpkg hold prevents installing.

spec.title: Apt
